description: 影视/短剧/动漫生成常用视觉风格库

entries.title: 写实电影感
entries.content: 写实电影感风格：cinematic realistic, film grain, natural lighting, shallow depth of field, 35mm film look, Arri Alexa color science, subtle color grading, lifelike textures, dramatic but believable atmosphere, soft shadows, high dynamic range.

entries.title: 都市情感
entries.content: 都市情感风格：modern urban romance, soft pastel tones, golden hour lighting, cozy interior, city skyline through window, warm bokeh, gentle emotional atmosphere, natural skin tones, shallow depth of field.

entries.title: 悬疑暗调
entries.content: 悬疑暗调风格：dark suspense thriller, low-key chiaroscuro lighting, Dutch angle, heavy shadows, foggy atmosphere, desaturated color grading, neon accents, tense mood, shallow depth of field, rain-slicked streets.

entries.title: 赛博朋克
entries.content: 赛博朋克风格：neon-lit cyberpunk city, volumetric fog, blue and pink rim lighting, reflective wet pavement, holographic advertisements, Blade Runner aesthetic, high contrast, futuristic dystopia, cinematic atmosphere.

entries.title: 古风仙侠
entries.content: 古风仙侠风格：Chinese wuxia xianxia style, flowing silk robes, misty mountains, traditional architecture, cherry blossom petals, sword energy effects, ethereal atmosphere, soft ink-wash aesthetics, jade accessories, bamboo forests.

entries.title: 国漫
entries.content: 国漫风格：Chinese anime guoman style, vibrant colors, detailed line art, dramatic expressions, dynamic poses, fantasy elements, elaborate costumes, particle effects, cinematic composition, high contrast shading.

entries.title: 动漫
entries.content: 动漫风格：Japanese anime style, cel shading, large expressive eyes, dynamic camera angles, speed lines, cherry blossoms, school uniform, emotional atmosphere, soft gradient backgrounds, vibrant hair colors.

entries.title: 卡通 3D
entries.content: 卡通 3D 风格：3D cartoon animation style, Pixar-like character design, soft rounded shapes, bright cheerful colors, volumetric lighting, subsurface scattering, expressive faces, clean environment, glossy materials.

entries.title: 东方水墨
entries.content: 东方水墨风格：Chinese ink wash painting style, monochrome ink gradients, misty mountains, flowing brushstrokes, minimalist composition, poetic atmosphere, traditional calligraphy elements, rice paper texture, serene mood.

entries.title: 童话绘本
